response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist software engineer (15+ years, staff-level titles, strong TypeScript/Node.js and distributed systems background) but does not meet the core requirement of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions. His AI exposure appears limited to roughly one year of MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no multi-agent frameworks, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only light cloud experience (AWS CDK). He would be a strong hire for a general platform/full-stack staff role, but the GenAI-specific depth this position demands is largely absent.
strengths: 15+ years of engineering experience with staff-level scope and strong TypeScript/Node.js depth
Hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience at current role
Proven mentoring, workshops, and public speaking — fits the customer-facing technical-leadership aspect
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of production AI/GenAI delivery as required
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent frameworks
Limited cloud-platform breadth (AWS CDK only) and Python not listed among skills

key_factors.factor: RAG / vector DB / agent framework knowledge
Senior full-stack engineering and mentoring track record
